title: Rich and wealthy are not the same people
hook: The person who looks rich is usually not the one who is.

headline: LOOKING RICH
ISN'T
WEALTHY.

scenes.say: The person who looks rich is usually not the one who is.
Rich is income. Wealthy is what's still there when the income stops.
High earner keeps {r_contrib} a year. Average earner keeps {w_contrib}. Same return, {w_rate}.
After {years} years, the average earner owns {gap_ratio} times more.
The car and the house are what people see. Real wealth is mostly invisible.
Measure wealth in months you could live without working, not in things you own.

takeaway: Measure wealth in months you could live without working, not in things you own.
